← Registration

Registration information

Online registration is not yet open. The course provider must publish the final refund and cancellation terms and a contact email here before accepting payments.

Payment options

USD $1,800 in one payment, or four monthly payments of USD $500, totaling USD $2,000. For installments, the first charge follows card authorization and three more charges follow monthly. The plan ends after four billing periods. A failed payment may be retried; authorization alone does not guarantee successful payment.

Your information

Name, email, phone, selected course, preferred schedule, consent, and payment references are used to manage registration and course communication. Records are kept on the registration backend and copied into the provider's local SQL database. Stripe handles payment details; card numbers are not stored in the course database.

Schedule confirmation

Your preferred schedule is a request and will be confirmed separately by the provider.

Before registration opens

The provider must add their contact email, refund and cancellation terms, data retention period, privacy request process, and final schedule confirmation arrangements.
